messages:
Alex (Support): heads-up — Polaris Health trial hit a hard stop during the EHR integration step. Their ingest job returns 500s on our webhook and they say trial users can't complete onboarding. 
Leah (Support): repro steps from customer: POST /v1/ingest -> 502, then retries -> 500. Happened ~10:40am PT. 
Alex (Support): throwing to CS — customer flagged renewal conversation scheduled next week. They said if this isn't fixed quickly they may pause expansion. 
Jamie (CS): @Alex thanks for the ping. Can you paste the last 3 error lines and the request id? Need to scope comms. 
Leah (Support): request_id: req_7b9f2a. Error snippet: ```error: upstream_gateway_timeout
trace: org.redwood.sdk.webhook:504
message: "failed to forward payload to customer EHR endpoint"``` 
Matt (Solutions): quick note — that looks like the customer endpoint is intermittently returning 504s. Could be their TLS config or a proxy in front. Did support capture the full webhook response headers? 
Alex (Support): headers attached in original ticket (link: https://app.redwood/tkt/7891). TL;DR: keepalive reset, remote closed conn. 
Jamie (CS): ok — immediate plan: 1) Chase customer infra (Polaris infra) to confirm if they changed IP allowlist or rotated certs; 2) Offer temporary proxying via our dedicated relay for onboarding traffic; 3) Escalate renewal comms to Olivia if they signal pause. I'll draft comms. 
Olivia (CS Manager): +1. If Polaris pauses, risk to renewal is high; escalate to AE and CSM lead. Jamie, please include suggested customer message for me to approve. Keep tone apologetic and clear about mitigation timeline. 
Leah (Support): FYI I toggled retries to backoff, but stopping retries for now while we validate endpoint stability. 
Matt (Solutions): If they can't update allowlist quickly, we can route onboarding calls through our relay for up to 72 hours. Need a signed temporary addendum (legal) for proxying PII — I can draft a minimal interim agreement. 
Alex (Support): customer replied: "we rolled a firewall update this morning, reverting now". They asked for rollback ETA. 
Jamie (CS): Draft message to Polaris: "Thanks — we see firewall change is likely root cause. Our suggestion: rollback or add Redwood relay IPs (x.x.x.x/32) while we stand up temporary proxy. We can enable proxy in 30–45m, legal sign-off required for PII handling. Do you want us to proceed?" Thoughts? 
Olivia (CS Manager): good. Add explicit ask: "Do you consent to a temporary relay and brief access window for debugging (no data retention beyond session)?" Keep timeframe 2 hours for customer decision, otherwise we'll schedule a follow-up call. 
Matt (Solutions): I'll prep the relay and sample addendum now. Tagging inc-bot for oncall network ticket if we need infra support. 
inc-bot: Incident ticket created — NET-4821 — relay staging requested. Assigned to infra-oncall. 
Jamie (CS): I'll post the draft in a DM to Olivia for sign-off, then send to Polaris. Also adding AE (Sam) so we're aligned on renewal messaging. 
Alex (Support): thanks team. I'll keep this thread updated with any inbound logs from Polaris. 
Leah (Support): Customer just confirmed rollback started. Watching for successful POSTs. 
Jamie (CS): Excellent — once we see a few green calls I'll schedule a 30-min enablement to walk Polaris through final steps and capture feedback to prevent recurrence. Recommend capturing two things: what caused firewall change, and whether they need IP allowlisting automation. 
Olivia (CS Manager): Good next steps. If they request a credits concession because of lost onboarding days, loop me in — we'll evaluate based on time to resolution. 
Alex (Support): last check 10:56am PT — 3 successful webhook deliveries. I'll close the immediate P1 if stable and update ticket. 
Jamie (CS): closing notes for record: escalation -> support triage -> temporary retry halt -> route/relay contingency -> legal addendum drafted -> customer rollback -> verify 3 successful calls -> enablement session scheduled. Will capture in CS handoff doc. 
Olivia (CS Manager): Thanks all. Jamie, please convert the thread summary into the formal comms plan and include next steps, owner, and SLA expectation for Polaris renewal touchpoint."
